title: Stopwatch time per revolution
description: Essential: Correctly applies time dilation to find the proper time for one revolution, yielding the expression with the Lorentz factor.

title: Lab frame clock offset
description: Essential: States that in the lab frame, the two stationary clocks are synchronized, so their offset is zero.

title: Clock A time in CIRF
description: Important: Correctly applies time dilation from the moving clock (Carla's stopwatch) to the lab clock (A) as observed in CIRF.

title: Clock B time in CIRF
description: Important: Derives the expression for Clock B's reading in CIRF, combining time dilation and the relativity of simultaneity term.

title: Time dilation reasoning
description: Important: Identifies and correctly applies the time dilation formula for a moving clock relative to an inertial frame.

title: Relativity of simultaneity
description: Important: Recognizes that Clock B is not synchronized with Clock A in the moving CIRF, leading to a positional time offset.

title: Correct angular argument
description: Optional: Correctly relates the elapsed proper time τ to the angular position (θ) of Carla on the track in the derivation.

title: Misapplied time dilation direction
description: Pitfall: Reverses the time dilation factor (e.g., uses γτ instead of τ/γ) when relating proper time to coordinate time.

title: Ignoring clock offset in CIRF
description: Pitfall: For Clock B in CIRF, omits the sinusoidal term from the relativity of simultaneity, giving only the dilated time.

title: Non-zero lab frame offset
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly claims a non-zero time offset between the two stationary clocks in the lab frame.
